head: claude/mgc-remediation-abort-attribution-contradiction
title: work: ABORT the MGC remediation — 548 is not stale and the attribution is contradicted
body:
## Verdict: ABORTED — the object's own sanctioned completion

`WO-20260908-RE-DISPATCH-THE-MGC-REMEDIATION-AGAINST-THE`. **Nothing was cancelled, modified, re-armed, closed, or written to the journal. No order was sent to any venue. No order-path code touched.**

## Why

**1. The approval's factual premise is false.** It states order `548` is "stale and is NOT what you are authorised against." Read live three times (`04:47:38Z`, `04:50:52Z`; per-account `read_state: orders_read`), 548 rests `PreSubmitted` as the stop leg of a **second, disjoint OCA group**. `550`/`551` did not replace it — they were added beside it.

| order | type | qty | stop | limit | OCA group | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **548** | STP | 11 | 4210.70 | — | `oca-protect-t5353` | PreSubmitted |
| **549** | LMT | 11 | — | 4807.50 | `oca-protect-t5353` | Submitted |
| **550** | STP | 43 | 4394.50 | — | `oca-protect-t5531` | PreSubmitted |
| **551** | LMT | 43 | — | 4485.00 | `oca-protect-t5531` | Submitted |

550/551 **do** rest exactly as described — the abort is *not* because those ids moved again. It is because the two orders the approval does not mention change what cancelling them means.

**2. The attribution the fix depends on is contradicted by the venue.** `WO-20260907` records MI-166's reading that trade 5531 holds the phantom 43, implying the venue's 11 real lots belong to trade 5353. The venue's average cost says the opposite:

| attribution of the venue's 11 lots | blended entry | vs venue 4432.696 |
|---|---|---|
| all from **5531** (@4430.70) | 4430.700 | **−0.045%** |
| all from **5353** (@4374.40) | 4374.400 | **−1.333%** |

**Control:** `ib_paper`/MHG is an exactly-reconciling pair (30 v 30, single journal row) and gives the normal journal-vs-venue gap: **+0.199%**. So 5531 lands inside the control and 5353 is 6.7× outside it. The MES control (row 4350) was **not available** — it falls below the `journal` id window (5248–5547), the truncation MI-177 documents — so this rests on **one** control pair, not two.

Both readings reproduce the +43 divergence exactly (11+32 vs 43), so the quantity sum cannot separate them. MI-177 says so itself: per-trade attribution "is a different question this instrument does not answer."

**On this evidence, cancelling 550/551 would strip protection off the only real MGC position at the venue** and leave 548/549 covering nothing — `BL-20260820-OVERCOVER-REMEDIATION-CANCELLED-THE-JOURNAL-MATCHING-LEG` a second time, same mechanism, same account.

**3. This class is deliberately detect-only.** Per `CLAUDE.md`, the over-cover side "pages and cancels nothing, because the one attempt to remediate this class automatically cancelled the leg that MATCHED the journal."

## Live risk, left exactly as found

Venue MGC **long 11** (two reads, `positions` populated, `error: null`). Resting **stop** quantity **11 + 43 = 54 against 11 — 491% over-cover across disjoint OCA groups**. OCA cancels only *within* a group, so whichever stop fires flattens the 11 and the other group's legs still rest to sell. **The abort avoids making this worse; it does not resolve it.**

## What is in the diff

- `docs/claude/work/MGC-REMEDIATION-ABORT-2026-09-08.md` — the evidence, populations stated, with what was **not** looked at called out (execution records were not consulted; `bybit_2`/`alpaca_live` exposure to this class is unexamined).
- First **TRUE** `blocked_on` edge on the object → `WO-20260907-ROOT-CAUSE-THE-43-PHANTOM-MGC-LOTS`, replacing `NOT_ASSESSED`.
- `DOCUMENT-INDEX.md` registration + landing declaration.

## Governance

The object on `main` is `lifecycle: dormant`, `owner: null`, `blocked_on_basis: NOT_ASSESSED` — parked by its own terms ("a captured idea is PARKED, not queued"). Cancelling a live resting protective leg is the live order path: **Tier-3, propose don't enact.** This PR is that proposal.

Opened **ready, not draft**, per the 2026-09-03 operator ruling — the hold is carried by `.github/pr-landing/mgc-remediation-abort-attribution-contradiction.json` (`tier: 3`, `landing: hold`, `hold_reason: tier_2_3_needs_approval`), and **no `pr-automerge-request` file is written**, so nothing self-lands.

⚠️ Board #6927 is at the 2500-comment cap and writes 403 — no START claim posted (MI-182, known/parked, not retried).

## Approval sought

From the operator, on two points: (1) the MGC remediation stays **ABORTED** until attribution is settled from execution records; (2) acknowledgement that **548 is live, not stale**, contrary to the 2026-09-08 approval's premise.
